directionSent: Continuous corpse search and discovery of Tyrmor's journal
heardByWhisper: You find corpse search and discovery of Tirmore's journal.  You find the corpse of a man.  The body has been stripped of weapons and armor, as well as any useful gear.  However, you find a book under the body.  It is the Journal of Tirmore.  It is fascinating, and you include much of its information in your journal as Entry 26.
